findings.title: Invoice has no per-department cost/seat breakdown for multi-department billing allocation
findings.description: Customer (finance) requests that invoices show charges broken out by department - seats and dollar amount per department line - instead of a single consolidated total, using the department tags already maintained in the platform for org-chart purposes. Today finance manually cross-references the member roster against a separate HR spreadsheet every month (2-3 hours) to apportion the single invoice across four cost centers (retail ~200 seats, warehouse ~150, corporate ~100, guiding operations the remainder). Missed department reassignments cause allocation errors that over/under-charge a department, which has escalated to the CFO twice this year and taken up to a week to resolve. No product-side workaround exists for the invoice itself; a CSV roster export only removes part of the manual matching step, not the core billing gap.
findings.quote: If the invoice itself broke out the cost by department.
findings.severity_reason: Recurring monthly manual-reconciliation burden and allocation errors that have twice escalated to the customer's CFO with week-long disputes; affects billing accuracy across all four of the customer's cost centers, though a manual workaround exists.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue covers per-department billing/invoice breakdown; PROJ-118 (PDF export of engagement dashboard) and PROJ-095 (CSV roster export) are unrelated capabilities, not invoice line-item splitting.

findings.title: Interim CSV roster export offered as stopgap pending per-department invoice split
findings.description: While the per-department invoice split is not yet built, support offered the already-shipped bulk CSV export of the member roster (Admin > Members > 'Export all CSV'), which includes a department column when tags are current. Customer confirmed this removes the need to separately cross-reference an HR spreadsheet for headcount-per-department, but explicitly noted it does not solve the underlying invoice-splitting problem.
findings.quote: And if there's any interim way to make Fiona's life easier before that exists?
findings.severity_reason: Not a new product gap - a stopgap for the already-filed invoice-split feature request, using an existing shipped export capability.
findings.match_note: Workaround for the invoice-split feature raised at L34; the export itself matches shipped feature PROJ-095 but is not a new ask here.

findings.title: Seasonal crew bulk provisioning and deactivate/reactivate flow confirmed working as intended
findings.description: Customer asked support to confirm that a bulk upload of 112 seasonal retail crew members on 2026-05-30 provisioned cleanly, and to confirm the correct flow for deactivating departing seasonal members and reactivating returning ones. Support confirmed the upload had no errors in the log, and that Admin > Members > Deactivate/Reactivate is correct, with reactivate preserving member history versus creating a duplicate record via re-adding. No defect or missing capability was identified during this exchange.
findings.quote: First, we added the seasonal retail crew last month and I want to confirm they provisioned cleanly.
findings.severity_reason: Purely a confirmation of existing, correctly-functioning behavior; no defect or gap raised.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies - this is a routine admin-flow confirmation, not a reported problem or feature gap.
